description: Canonical wiki folder layout for tablinum. version is the migration signal: bump it whenever the layout changes, add a rename entry and/or a bin/migrations/NNN script for the change, and the laptop's migrate-structure.sh will pick it up on next sync.

folders.holds: Conceptual knowledge, distinguished by type: concepts/ideas/explanations, architecture patterns (type: pattern), glossary terms (type: glossary), open questions (type: question), comparisons. Open questions are picked up later via the dashboard Open Questions view.
People and companies/teams (the org map — everyone and every organization). NOT products, repos, or running systems.
Technology/stack inventory — one page per language/framework/library/db/infra/product (type: technology). Ingested tech docs under technologies/docs/.
Ingested documents / URLs, and code repositories (repo pages)
Sources captured but not yet properly ingested/written up — a triage queue
Time-bound work with an outcome (one folder per project)
Session notes (/save) and general meeting notes not tied to a specific project — dated records
How the systems + org run: services (catalog), runbooks, incidents/postmortems, and processes (repeatable procedures, each linking the tools it needs and the project it serves)

renames.note: entities is now the single home for all people
entities is now the single home for all companies/teams
processes fold into the operations hub
a comparison is a concept with a verdict
open questions live in concepts, kept distinct by type: question
the operating manual is meta, not a resources sibling
a pattern is a concept (type: pattern)
a glossary term is a concept (type: glossary)
engineering drops the projects inbox; sessions get a real top-level home
